---
name: vibeschool-evidence-status
description: Bind VibeSchool implementation/readiness/certification/merge/production status language to fresh evidence for exact scope and SHA.
---
# Evidence Status
Use strict states: IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED, RECONCILED, CERTIFIED, MERGED, POST_MERGE_VERIFIED and PRODUCTION_VERIFIED only when fresh evidence proves that exact scope/revision. Missing, stale, contradicted or narrower evidence forces the narrower claim. Narrative confidence, screenshots, old CI and previous assistant reports cannot upgrade status. Record evidence provenance and invalidation when dependencies or heads move.
